derivation: amendment A13: a link whose rel tokens include `stylesheet` alongside `alternate` is not an alternate, so its invalid-looking hreflang is not judged; the page's en self alternate remains.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate stylesheet" hreflang="en_US" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: clean-alternate-stylesheet
